cards.label: Layer
cards.copy: Defines semantic meaning before any primitive or component consumes color.

cards.label: Primary axis
cards.copy: Every color choice must map to one of these roles.

cards.label: Forbidden
cards.copy: No status or action color appears without product meaning.

Energy.code:
energy.foundation
roles: action | success | warning | error | surface | inverse
input: product intent + interaction state
output: sys.energy.* semantic roles
consumer: Color primitive, Button, Alert, Card, Dashboard, Map

cards.label: Layer
cards.copy: Owns spacing, density, rhythm, grid, breakpoints, and grouping.

cards.label: Base unit
cards.copy: All page, section, panel, component, and inline spacing resolves to the scale.

cards.label: Density
cards.copy: SM/MD/LG is declared by context and inherited.

Frame.code:
frame.foundation
space: 0 | 4 | 8 | 12 | 16 | 20 | 24 | 32 | 40 | 48 | 64 | 80
radius: control | container | surface | full
density: sm | md | lg
grid: mobile 1col | tablet 6col | desktop 12col

cards.label: Layer
cards.copy: Defines when motion communicates feedback, continuity, choreography, or system activity.

cards.label: Durations
cards.copy: The scale mirrors the reference Momentum foundation.

cards.label: Accessibility
cards.copy: Meaning survives when movement is minimized.

Momentum.code:
momentum.foundation
duration: instant | fast | normal | slow | slower | cycle
easing: standard | enter | exit | linear
stagger: fast 30ms | normal 50ms | slow 80ms
consumer: Route sheet, quick actions, loading, dashboard reveal, onboarding

cards.label: Layer
cards.copy: Owns elevation, overlays, blur, and layer order before any surface renders.

cards.label: Levels
cards.copy: Canvas, raised, floating, overlay, and critical feedback never share arbitrary shadows.

cards.label: Stacking
cards.copy: Dropdowns, sticky chrome, overlays, dialogs, and toasts use named depth roles.

Depth.code:
depth.foundation
elevation: 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4
overlay: light | dark
z: dropdown | sticky | overlay | dialog | toast
consumer: Surface, Card, Menu, Dialog, Sheet, Toast, Command

cards.label: Layer
cards.copy: Defines interaction states and how conflicts resolve before visual styling.

cards.label: Required
cards.copy: Interactive artifacts must expose navigable and pointer state.

cards.label: Precedence
cards.copy: Conflicting states resolve predictably instead of layering random styles.

State.code:
state.foundation
states: default | hover | pressed | focus | selected | loading | disabled | error | success
visuals: overlay | focus-ring | opacity | busy-animation | border
consumer: Button, Select, Inputs, Cards, Menus, Templates

cards.label: Layer
cards.copy: Governs message structure for labels, guidance, warnings, repair, and confirmation.

cards.label: Principle
cards.copy: Messages explain what happened, consequence, and next useful action.

cards.label: Scope
cards.copy: Tone changes labels, helper text, alerts, empty states, and support paths.

Tone.code:
tone.foundation
roles: neutral | assistive | urgent | repair | confirm
structure: object + condition + consequence + next action
consumer: EmptyState, InlineValidation, Toast, Dialog, Template copy

cards.label: Layer
cards.copy: Defines maturity, adoption signals, deprecation, and product learning.

cards.label: Stages
cards.copy: Artifacts move through visible maturity states.

cards.label: Privacy
cards.copy: Events are structured and semantic without exposing personal data.

Growth.code:
growth.foundation
stages: seed | stable | measured | deprecated
events: impression | interaction | completion | abandonment | error
consumer: Components, Patterns, Templates, Release notes, Analytics

cards.label: Layer
cards.copy: Defines visual language, icon sizing, modular illustrations, and product symbols.

cards.label: Icon source
cards.copy: The library is raw material; Design System owns semantic mapping and access rules.

cards.label: Assets
cards.copy: Symbols inherit color, spacing, stroke, state, and reduced-motion policy.

Symbol.code:
symbol.foundation
sizes: sm | md | lg
roles: action | status | domain | navigation | object
consumer: Icon, IconButton, EmptyState, Onboarding, Templates

cards.label: Layer
cards.copy: Defines functional glyph rules and semantic icon categories.

cards.label: Grid
cards.copy: Icons align to a predictable grid, live area, stroke, and optical size.

cards.label: Access
cards.copy: Icon-only actions require accessible labels and touch-safe targets.

Iconography.code:
iconography.foundation
grid: 24px
live-area: 20px
stroke: 1.5px
consumer: Material Symbols wrapper, IconButton, navigation, status glyphs

cards.label: Layer
cards.copy: Defines access guarantees across keyboard, touch, screen reader, contrast, and motion.

cards.label: Minimum
cards.copy: Touch actions meet operational mobile constraints.

cards.label: Recovery
cards.copy: Denied permission, offline, and reduced-motion states still complete the task.

Accessibility.code:
accessibility.foundation
paths: keyboard | touch | screen-reader | contrast | reduced-motion | recovery
rules: name + role + state + focus + escape + fallback
consumer: every component, pattern, template, and agent output
